claims.statement: The 15-question batch contains exactly 3 questions for each of 5 Core cards in Base / Trap / Apply order.
signal_weight is accepted only as 1–2 salience metadata; it does not alter accuracy, weak-skill thresholds or causal remediation.
Each micro-question has exactly one assessed skill; prerequisite/support skills are stored separately to prevent cross-skill accuracy contamination.
Canonical algebraic answers for Q4, Q5, Q6, Q10–Q15 were independently recomputed; all simplify to the authored answers.
triet-tieu-sai-hang-tu remains an observed signal; no new Knowledge Graph node or causal remediation edge is created in this pilot.

proposed_changes.change: Render the complete 15-question bank inline as 3-question micro-practice per Core card.
proposed_changes.rationale: Close the learning → evidence → Tutor feedback loop in the pilot.

proposed_changes.change: Practice Engine and Learning Cards record to the same localStorage evidence model with bounded recent observed signals.
proposed_changes.rationale: Avoid a second incompatible quiz/evidence engine.

tests.expected: Every question has four options, valid answer and at most one primary observed signal per distractor.
MTC items use largest required exponent.
Canonical answers independently recomputed before integration.
All modified JavaScript parses and workspace/bank references are structurally valid.
Deployed desktop/iPad/mobile interaction has no blocking UX defects.

uncertainties: Real-device/browser QA remains required before freezing the template for bulk rollout.

acceptance.notes: Content/schema/structural QA passed. Pilot is QA-ready but not template-frozen until deployed device QA passes.
